{{Quote|By the Twi'lek Goddess, your brother handles his lightsaber well, Cay.|Tott Doneeta|audio=ByTheTwilekGoddess-TotJaudio.flac|<ref name="TotJ">[[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
A [[Gender/Legends|feminine]] divinity, the '''Twi'lek Goddess''' was the only deity worshiped by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] people of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> [[Tott Doneeta]], a Twi'lek [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], frequently called out to this Goddess during the events leading up to, and during, the [[Beast Wars]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]].<ref name="TotJ" />
